title: Blendshape Generation for Models with Disconnected Parts: Adding ARKit/MediaPipe Blendshapes to Anime-Style Character Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.35076v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Blendshape generation for 3D models has been extensively researched, but very few works address generating blendshapes for models with multiple disconnected parts. We present a case study of generating fixed facial expression blendshapes for commercial anime-style 3D character models with up to 11 parts per face. To make sure that our system can handle models in a way that is agnostic to topology, we train neural networks to generate deformation fields around the input meshes. We employ at least one network to independently process each part, and the relative positions of their outputs are coordinated by having each network also process the geometry of an anchor part. We use two mechanisms to improve accuracy: having the networks predict whether the output displacement is zero or not, and classifying blendshapes into different size groups and dedicating a network to each group. translated_title: 面向不连通部件模型的混合变形生成：为动漫风格角色模型添加ARKit/MediaPipe混合变形
translated_abstract: 3D模型的混合变形生成已被广泛研究，但很少有工作涉及为具有多个不连通部件的模型生成混合变形。我们展示了一个案例研究：为商业动漫风格3D角色模型生成固定的面部表情混合变形，这些模型的面部最多包含11个部件。为了确保我们的系统能够以拓扑无关的方式处理模型，我们训练神经网络在输入网格周围生成变形场。我们使用至少一个网络独立处理每个部件，并通过让每个网络同时处理锚定部件的几何形状来协调各网络输出的相对位置。我们采用两种机制来提高精度：让网络预测输出位移是否为零，以及将混合变形划分为不同的大小组并为每组指定专门的网络。我们还介绍了一种提升混合变形质量的方法。
tldr: 提出一种拓扑无关的神经网络方法，通过为每个部件分配独立网络并借助锚定部件几何协调输出，为面部包含多达11个不连通部件的动漫风格3D角色模型生成ARKit/MediaPipe标准面部表情混合变形。
en_tdlr: A topology-agnostic neural network approach that generates ARKit/MediaPipe facial expression blendshapes for anime-style 3D character models with up to 11 disconnected face parts, using independent per-part networks coordinated through anchor-part geometry.
